degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every boundary case listed in scope-map.md.

a Hopf theorem producing periodic orbits from a source-specific eigenvalue crossing
a period-doubling, homoclinic, global, structural-stability, or generic bifurcation result

boundary, nonisolated, or nonunique equilibria and invariant objects
one-sided parameter neighborhoods and finite-time or nonunique trajectories
zero or repeated eigenvalues and eigenvalues on the imaginary axis or unit circle
resonance, vanishing nondegeneracy coefficients, and symmetry-forced branches
coordinate, time, and parameter changes and behavior on one or both sides of the critical value
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1363 chaos theory or THM-M-1366 structural stability
an implicit-function persistence result presented as an existence or classification theorem for bifurcations
a single normal-form example, numerical continuation, simulation, or plotted bifurcation diagram

generic ODE, flow, fixed-point, derivative, continuity, or implicit-function APIs alone
